newsitem.title: UKRAINE: De Beers geologists visit Ukraine.
newsitem.headline: De Beers geologists visit Ukraine.

text.p: South African diamond giant De Beers Consolidated Mines Ltd is interested in exploring diamond deposits on Ukraine's Azov Sea coastline, a spokeswoman for the state geological body said on Thursday.
"Talks with De Beers officials were held here in recent days," Izabella Tarasova, a spokeswoman for the State Geology Committee, told Reuters.
She said no deals had been signed yet, but De Beers had expressed interest in Ukrainian diamond deposits.
Raymond Clarke, head of De Beers' Moscow representation, confirmed that company geologists were in Ukraine last week, but gave no further details.
"We had a team of geologists down there last week, it's true," he said.
Ukrainian geologists have discovered diamond deposits along the coast of the Azov Sea and in the southeastern Donetsk region.
Some diamond deposits were also discovered on the banks of Ukraine's biggest river, Dnieper, and on the Buh river in the south of the former Soviet republic.
A diamond polishing plant in Kiev has been working with Russian stones from the Yakutia-Sakha region since Soviet times.
